name: EEB 5872
title: Environmental Risk Assessment
description: An overview of understanding risks to ecosystems and ecosystem services across landscape scales, including how to predict and manage risks to food, energy, water, and ecosystems in the face of global change. Topics include working with stakeholders, identifying risks and objectives, quantifying risks, creating alternative mitigation strategies, and communicating them with stakeholders and the public.
requirement_description: Open to students in the Team-TERRA program; others with consent.
